description: Health terms from outside the knowledge base for the vague-query rule (src/vagueQuery.js). Written by hand, by whole category of general sexual and reproductive health vocabulary, not from any test query. Terms are lowercase and written as the rule normalises a query (apostrophes and punctuation removed); a term with a space is a phrase, matched against the whole query. The gateway reads this file; scripts/build-health-terms.js copies it into the offline queryRules.ts, and a test fails if the copy is out of date. Decision: docs/decision-log.md, 'Health terms from outside the knowledge base (2026-10-20)'.

categories.name: contraceptive methods and names
categories.criterion: A contraceptive method, device or brand name in common use in Kenya, or a common way of describing one (including withdrawal).

categories.name: menstrual and body
categories.criterion: Menstrual products and periods, the reproductive and urinary body, and common words for genital symptoms or sexual activity.

categories.name: STIs and HIV
categories.criterion: A sexually transmitted infection, HIV, a common genital infection, or a medicine or test for one.

categories.name: pregnancy
categories.criterion: Pregnancy, conception, its care and its end, and the words commonly used for a pregnancy scare (a late or missed period, a positive or negative test).
